_meta.purpose: Build specification for the Thaus studio website. Paste this into Claude Code as the source of truth for scaffolding and building the site.
instructionsToAgent: Build a production-quality Next.js (App Router) site that matches this spec exactly: colors, fonts, icons, spacing, animation feel.
Aesthetic keyword: minimalist, professional, 'terminal-meets-studio'. Flat surfaces, no gradients, no drop-shadows except subtle elevation on cards.
Animations must be light and smooth, primarily on-scroll reveals and gentle hover. Never heavy, bouncy, or distracting. Always respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Single-page scroll layout with anchor navigation. Sections in the order listed under layout.sectionOrder.
Contact form and newsletter are UI-ONLY for now. Do NOT build a backend. Wire the submit handlers to clearly-marked TODO functions so they can be connected to an n8n webhook later.
Place logo/favicon files from the Thaus brand pack in /public (see assets section) and reference them.
Keep code clean, typed, componentized, and commented where a human will later wire integrations.
placeholdersToFill: portfolio.items[0] (Zynth): add real one-line description, tags, and a screenshot image at /public/portfolio/zynth.png
integrations: connect contact form + newsletter to n8n webhooks later (endpoints marked TODO)

project.name: Thaus
project.tagline: Complete business systems, built in public.
project.description: Faceless digital product studio that builds complete business systems (web + automation) and documents the process in public.
project.targetAudience: Global, English-speaking. Small businesses / founders who want a full done-for-you web + automation system, plus an audience following the build-in-public journey.

setupCommands: npx shadcn@latest add button input textarea

designSystem.aesthetic: Minimalist, professional, terminal-meets-studio. Generous whitespace, precise alignment, monospace accents for labels and numbers.

accent.usage: cobalt — CTAs, links, cursor, active states, focus rings, tag highlights

tailwindTokens.note: Expose the above as CSS variables and Tailwind theme colors (e.g. bg-bg, text-ink, text-dim, bg-accent, border-line).

displayFont.usage: headings, wordmark, hero, section titles. Tight letter-spacing (-0.02em to -0.03em) on large sizes.

monoFont.usage: eyebrows/kickers, section labels, tags, numbers, statuses, captions. Uppercase with wide letter-spacing (0.12em-0.16em) for labels.

icons.style: 1.5px stroke, size 18-20px inline, 24px for section markers. Use sparingly: ArrowUpRight (external/links), ArrowRight (CTA), Mail, Send, Github, Instagram, Menu, X, Check, Terminal/SquareDashed (accents).

layoutRules.sectionPadding: py-24 to py-32 desktop, py-16 mobile
layoutRules.borders: 1px solid var(--line) for cards and inputs
layoutRules.shadows: flat by default; optional very subtle elevation on card hover only
layoutRules.grid: optional faint background grid or a thin top hairline; keep extremely subtle

animations.feel: Light, smooth, refined. Subtle entrances on scroll, gentle hover. Nothing bouncy or heavy.

globals.reducedMotion: Detect prefers-reduced-motion and disable transforms/opacity animations, render final state instantly.

scrollReveal.trigger: whileInView with viewport={{ once: true, amount: 0.3 }}
scrollReveal.variant: from { opacity: 0, y: 20 } to { opacity: 1, y: 0 }

stagger.usage: portfolio cards, footer links, hero elements

patterns.heroEntrance: Kicker -> H1 -> subhead -> CTAs revealed in sequence via stagger on mount (not scroll).

hover.cards: translateY(-4px) + border color to accent + subtle surface lighten, duration 0.25s
hover.links: underline grow from left or color to accent

patterns.cursorAccent: A blinking cobalt cursor block after the wordmark/hero headline (CSS keyframe blink 1.15s steps(1) infinite).
patterns.portfolioTransitions: Use AnimatePresence + layout animations so that when more items are added/filtered later, cards animate position smoothly (layout prop). Cards reveal with stagger on first view.
patterns.navOnScroll: Sticky nav gains a subtle backdrop-blur + bottom hairline (border-line) after scrolling ~40px; animate opacity of the background.

doNot: No parallax-heavy hero, no large scroll-jacking, no auto-playing carousels, no confetti/particles, no long (>0.8s) animations.

layout.navigation: anchor links scrolling to section ids with smooth scroll behavior

content.mobile: Hamburger (lucide Menu/X) opening a minimal full-width dark menu with the same links.

nav.behavior: Transparent at top; after 40px scroll add backdrop-blur + border-line bottom hairline.

content.headline: Complete business systems, built in public.
content.headlineNote: Render a blinking cobalt cursor block right after the headline.
content.subhead: We build the whole thing — website, automations, CRM, and the growth engine behind it. Then we document every step in the open.

portfolio.heading: Selected systems
portfolio.grid: responsive: 1 col mobile, 2 col tablet, 3 col desktop. Currently 1 item; layout should look intentional with a single card (left-aligned, not stretched full width).

seo.title: Thaus — Complete business systems, built in public.
seo.description: Faceless digital product studio building complete business systems — web + automation — and documenting the process in the open.

requirements: Visible focus states in accent color.
Sufficient contrast (ink/dim on bg pass WCAG AA).
All interactive elements keyboard reachable; form labels associated.

steps: Configure next/font for Space Grotesk (400/500/700) and JetBrains Mono (400/700); expose as CSS variables --font-display and --font-mono.
Add the color CSS variables to globals.css and map them in tailwind.config as theme colors.
Copy brand assets into /public (logo/, favicon files).
Build components: Nav, Hero, Portfolio (PortfolioCard), Contact (ContactForm), Newsletter, Footer, plus a shared Section wrapper and a Reveal (Framer Motion) wrapper component.
Implement animation patterns via a reusable Reveal component and Framer Motion variants file.
Set metadata (title, description, favicon, og) in app/layout.tsx.
Ensure fully responsive (mobile-first) and test reduced-motion.

componentSuggestions.Reveal: Wrapper using motion.div with whileInView + variants for scrollReveal/stagger.
componentSuggestions.Section: Consistent padding + max-width container + optional id anchor.
componentSuggestions.PortfolioCard: Uses motion + layout prop for future smooth reordering.

doNotYet: No database, no auth, no CMS, no real email sending — UI and stubs only.

futureSections: Individual project detail pages / build archive
